title: Check yourself
intro: Three questions about how this course is put together. Replace them with questions about your subject.

items.prompt: What registers a course with the site?

options.text: Adding a directory with a valid course.json under courses/
Adding a route to a routing table
Adding a link to the navigation

items.explanation: Discovery scans courses/*/course.json. There is no route table and no navigation file to edit.

items.prompt: What does "status": "draft" in the manifest do?

options.text: Marks the course as unfinished in the UI
Keeps the course out of the built site entirely
Hides the course from search engines only

items.explanation: A draft course is validated but not rendered: nothing is written to dist/ for it until you flip it to live.

items.prompt: How does the lesson rail know what comes after this page?

options.text: Alphabetical order of the files in lessons/
The order listed in lessons.order in the manifest
A prev/next link written into each markdown file

items.explanation: lessons.order is the single source of truth for sequence; the build fails if an id in it has no file.
